Hymn 322: Come, All Ye Sons of God
Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 322 titled "Come, All Ye Sons of God" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Thomas Dunstan and the lyrics were written by Thomas Davenport.
